project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 13 of 16 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Wymondham qualifies as a local detour through THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF ST PETER. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Wymondham: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Wymondham offers THE PRIORY, CHURCH OF ST PETER, Churchyard cross in St Peter's churchyard within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: THE PRIORY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF ST PETER, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Churchyard cross in St Peter's churchyard
